mediaWork.focusOrTheme: In-depth examination of the juvenile interrogation, coerced confession, and wrongful conviction of Brendan Dassey in Manitowoc County, Wisconsin.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Limited investigative series (18 episodes) examining the 2006 interrogation, trial, and post-conviction appeals of Brendan Dassey, focusing on juvenile false confession dynamics and legal failures highlighted after Making a Murderer.
